checkedAlternates.risk: Back-formation shortens an existing word like clipping.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Back-formation removes a perceived affix to create a new part of speech (group-1), whereas clipping shortens a word without changing its category (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: Blends combine two words like compounds.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Blends fuse clipped fragments of words (group-2), whereas compounds join whole morphemes/words (group-4).
